#### Tools

```{r}
#### Translate
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

#### Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results){
  return(table(results$family)[order(table(results$family), decreasing = T)])
}

unproductive <- function(results){
  return(results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),])
}
```

# Rule-based Method

## Load Data


```{r, warning=F}
S1 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S1_Rule-based_families24Jan24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
S1$experiment <- rep("S1", each = nrow(S1))
S2 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S2_Rule-based_families24Jan24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
S2$experiment <- rep("S2", each = nrow(S2))
S3 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S3_Rule-based_families24Jan24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
S3$experiment <- rep("S3", each = nrow(S3))

df <- rbind(S1, S2, S3)

df <- df[!is.na(df$junction_aa),]

df$VHH <- translate_DNA(df$sequence_alignment)

df <- unproductive(df)
```

## Make Logo Plots for the top 25 clusters (for each experiment)

* **Note:** In order to plot the VHH's, I would need to align them-- takes time

## Logos

```{r}
for (experiment_id in unique(df$experiment)){
  
  tmp_one <- df[df$experiment == experiment_id,]
  tab <- top_groups(tmp_one)
  tmp <- tmp_one[tmp_one$family %in% head(as.numeric(names(tab)), 25),]
  
    for (nm in unique(tmp$family)){
      tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$family == as.numeric(nm),]
      
      common_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa)[order(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])
      
      cat("Experiment: ", experiment_id, ' \n', sep = '')
      cat("Group ID: ", unique(tmp_frame$family), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')

      print("Writing...")
      file_name <- paste("~/VHH/data/clustering_results/Rule-Based-Cluster_",experiment_id,"_Family_",unique(tmp_frame$family),"_Median-CRD3_",common_CDR3,".csv", sep = '')
      print(file_name)
      
      
      #tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[,c("junction_aa", "experiment", "family", "VHH", "sequence_id")]

}
```
